title: OTHRYS OS Knowledge and Mnemosyne surface
goal: Expose canonical OTHRYS knowledge stock as a read-only Knowledge surface without building a second memory system.
laws: Knowledge entries point to existing canonical or explicitly research-classified files only.
The surface does not promote research into law or implementation authority.
No file editing, indexing, embedding, Atlas clone or memory mutation is added.
Knowledge class and source path remain visible.
Missing source files fail visibly rather than being invented.
Mnemosyne remains a future deeper integration, not a renamed sidebar list.
Any write or autonomous memory maintenance requires a separate mission.
